nakshatras.name: Ashvinī
nakshatras.daily: Fast starts, movement and initiative are emphasized in traditional readings.
nakshatras.weekly: Review speed versus patience; keep commitments clear.
nakshatras.monthly: Use the month to develop disciplined momentum rather than rushing every decision.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of initiative, recovery and forward movement.

nakshatras.name: Bharanī
nakshatras.daily: Responsibility, boundaries and completion are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Balance obligations with rest and clear communication.
nakshatras.monthly: Themes of responsibility and transformation may recur in traditional interpretations.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of endurance, responsibility and renewal.

nakshatras.name: Kṛttikā
nakshatras.daily: Clarity, discernment and decisive action are traditional themes.
nakshatras.weekly: Separate useful priorities from distractions.
nakshatras.monthly: Refinement and disciplined choices are emphasized.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of purification, focus and leadership.

nakshatras.name: Rohinī
nakshatras.daily: Growth, creativity and material cultivation are traditional themes.
nakshatras.weekly: Build steadily and protect what is valuable.
nakshatras.monthly: Creative and resource-building themes can be developed patiently.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of cultivation, beauty and stability.

nakshatras.name: Mrigashīrsha
nakshatras.daily: Curiosity, searching and learning are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Investigate before committing.
nakshatras.monthly: Learning and exploration may open useful perspectives.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of inquiry, movement and discovery.

nakshatras.name: Ardra
nakshatras.daily: Change, analysis and emotional processing are traditional themes.
nakshatras.weekly: Use clarity and patience during unsettled situations.
nakshatras.monthly: Transformative learning can be constructive when handled deliberately.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of renewal through change.

nakshatras.name: Punarvasu
nakshatras.daily: Recovery, return and renewal are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Revisit what still has value before starting something new.
nakshatras.monthly: Restoration and second chances are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of renewal, generosity and return.

nakshatras.name: Pushya
nakshatras.daily: Learning, nourishment and disciplined support are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Strengthen foundations and routines.
nakshatras.monthly: Mentorship and steady growth are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of nourishment, duty and constructive growth.

nakshatras.name: Āshleshā
nakshatras.daily: Strategy, perception and careful communication are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Read situations carefully and avoid unnecessary entanglement.
nakshatras.monthly: Psychological insight and boundaries may become important themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of depth, strategy and transformation.

nakshatras.name: Maghā
nakshatras.daily: Heritage, authority and responsibility are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Respect experience while keeping decisions practical.
nakshatras.monthly: Leadership and family legacy themes may recur.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of ancestry, dignity and stewardship.

nakshatras.name: Pūrva Phalgunī
nakshatras.daily: Creativity, enjoyment and relationship themes are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Make room for both pleasure and responsibility.
nakshatras.monthly: Creative expression and social connection are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of creativity, comfort and connection.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Phalgunī
nakshatras.daily: Agreements, service and dependable partnership are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Put commitments in clear terms.
nakshatras.monthly: Stable alliances and practical cooperation are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of lasting agreements and responsibility.

nakshatras.name: Hasta
nakshatras.daily: Skill, organization and practical execution are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Use craftsmanship and attention to detail.
nakshatras.monthly: Hands-on learning and useful systems are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of skill, order and constructive action.

nakshatras.name: Chitrā
nakshatras.daily: Design, refinement and independent expression are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Improve the structure before polishing the appearance.
nakshatras.monthly: Creative construction and presentation are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of artistry, design and refinement.

nakshatras.name: Svātī
nakshatras.daily: Independence, flexibility and self-direction are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Adapt without losing your core direction.
nakshatras.monthly: Independent learning and movement are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of autonomy, flexibility and growth.

nakshatras.name: Vishākhā
nakshatras.daily: Goal focus, persistence and branching choices are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Choose one clear priority and follow through.
nakshatras.monthly: Ambition and strategic direction are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of determination and purposeful achievement.

nakshatras.name: Anurādhā
nakshatras.daily: Cooperation, friendship and disciplined devotion are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Strong alliances benefit from consistency.
nakshatras.monthly: Partnership and shared purpose are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of loyalty, friendship and disciplined devotion.

nakshatras.name: Jyēṣṭha
nakshatras.daily: Protection, responsibility and seniority are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Carry authority carefully and avoid needless control.
nakshatras.monthly: Leadership under pressure is a traditional theme.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of protection, responsibility and resilience.

nakshatras.name: Mūla
nakshatras.daily: Root-cause analysis, release and rebuilding are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Fix foundations before expanding.
nakshatras.monthly: Deep investigation and simplification are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of roots, truth-seeking and renewal.

nakshatras.name: Pūrva Ashādhā
nakshatras.daily: Confidence, persuasion and renewal are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Communicate clearly without overextending.
nakshatras.monthly: Courage and self-renewal are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of invigoration and conviction.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Ashādhā
nakshatras.daily: Persistence, ethics and durable achievement are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Prefer dependable progress over quick recognition.
nakshatras.monthly: Long-term responsibility is a traditional theme.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of lasting victory through discipline.

nakshatras.name: Shravana
nakshatras.daily: Listening, learning and information flow are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Observe carefully before responding.
nakshatras.monthly: Education and communication are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of learning, listening and transmission.

nakshatras.name: Dhanishta
nakshatras.daily: Rhythm, resources and collective activity are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Coordinate people and timing carefully.
nakshatras.monthly: Resource management and group activity are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of rhythm, prosperity and community.

nakshatras.name: Shatabhisha
nakshatras.daily: Analysis, independence and healing-oriented reflection are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Create space for research and recovery.
nakshatras.monthly: Innovation and introspection are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of inquiry, independence and restoration.

nakshatras.name: Pūrva Bhādrapadā
nakshatras.daily: Idealism, intensity and principled choices are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Keep ideals connected to practical steps.
nakshatras.monthly: Deep conviction and transformation are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of idealism, austerity and transformation.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Bhādrapadā
nakshatras.daily: Stability, patience and deep reflection are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Build quietly and consistently.
nakshatras.monthly: Long-term consolidation is a traditional theme.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of depth, patience and stability.

nakshatras.name: Revatī
nakshatras.daily: Completion, guidance and safe journeys are emphasized.
nakshatras.weekly: Close open loops and support transitions.
nakshatras.monthly: Completion and movement are traditional themes.
nakshatras.yearly: A traditional theme of guidance, completion and safe passage.

nakshatras.name: Abhijit
nakshatras.daily: Traditionally treated as an auspicious intercalary nakshatra in selected muhurta traditions.
nakshatras.weekly: Use only where the chosen Panchang tradition explicitly includes Abhijit.
nakshatras.monthly: Its use is methodology-dependent rather than universal.
nakshatras.yearly: Reference only; not part of the standard 27-nakshatra sequence.
